niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice span Jungian psychology, Tibetan Buddhist methods, and somatic healing:
Encounters with the Shadow (Jung Platform): Taught by Jungian analyst James Hollis ($127). It features 4 classes exploring shadow formation, projection in relationships, and repeating patterns to foster psychological responsibility and individuation. Jung Platform
Shadow Work Course and Workbook (Udemy): Created by Elaina Bianca ($11.99). It features a 98-page companion workbook, sensory shadow exploration, the onion model of the self, and healing modalities like journaling and dreams. Udemy
Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self (Udemy): Taught by spiritual teacher Melanie Stevens. It includes 48 lectures, heart-chakra self-care, trigger identification, and guided meditations. Udemy
Embracing The Shadow (Awake Academy): Taught by Charlie Morley. It blends shadow work with Tibetan Buddhist practices like Tonglen, lucid dreaming, ancestral shadow healing, and mask/mirror work. www.awakeacademy.org +1
Embracing All of Who You Are: Three-Day Shadow Practice Workshop (Real Life Programs): Facilitated by Diane Musho Hamilton and Cindy Lou Golin. It offers 18 hours of live online Zoom training focusing on integral shadow practice and group facilitation. Real Life Programs
Facing the Shadow (Big Shakti): Guided by Jayne and Swami Shankardev. It explores why focusing strictly on "spiritual light" creates imbalance and integrates traditional yogic and shadow-integration principles. Big Shakti
Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth (Insight Timer): A 10-day, 10-minute-per-day audio course by Sefy Tofan focused on triggers, somatic awareness, and inner-child healing. Insight Timer
Shadow Work Playlist (YouTube / Jordan Thornton): A free 15-video, 5-hour breakdown covering Jungian concepts, active imagination, somatic release, and breaking trauma bonds. YouTube·Jordan Thornton - Inner Work
